ehrenamtsmesse-bayreuth-2026.beschreibung:
After a long journey, our 1st chairwoman Tatjana Belmar and our 2nd chairwoman Franziska Künstler presented KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. at the volunteering fair in Bayreuth.

Our stand led to many appreciative conversations, new encounters and lovely contacts. We are very grateful to have been part of this special volunteering fair and to have had the chance to present our association there.

Thank you for the many open conversations and the great interest in our work.

A woman in an association T-shirt sits at the stand, writing. In front of her are flyers, cards and sweets, behind her the association's banner.
Sign stand with the poster for the petition “Secure care first. Then change care benefits!” and a QR code for signing.
